title: Authoryze: Your agent never sees your real card
excerpt: Authoryze gives each agent purchase a single-use virtual card. A breach leaks one disposable card, not your funding source.
content_html:
MCP-native payment infrastructure

The authorization and control layer for AI agent payments

Authoryze lets your AI agents pay for things across modern payment rails, while you enforce spending limits, approvals, merchant rules, and a complete audit trail. Purchasing power for your agents, control for you.

Control every dimension of agent spending.

Limits, approvals, merchant rules, and a full audit trail, all enforced server-side.

Where agents spend.

Real purchases agents make once you hand them a card with rules attached.

Pay-as-it-runs API spend

Your agent tops up OpenAI, Anthropic, or any API it depends on, drawing a single-use card for each charge instead of holding your real one.

Campaigns that fund themselves

Your agent refills Google or Meta ad budgets as campaigns run, scoped to the amount you approved, never your actual card.

Subscriptions on the agent's tab

Your agent signs up for the data, scraping, or software tools it needs, each on a disposable card that dies after the charge.

Buys the drop, within limits

Your bot checks out a limited sneaker release the instant it goes live, auto-approved because it's under your threshold and the store is on your allowed list, no card shared, no standing access.

Your real card is never exposed.

When an agent is ready to pay, Authoryze issues a single-use virtual card scoped to that one approved purchase, over Mastercard or Visa. Your real card and funding details never reach the agent. Each card works once, for the approved amount, then it’s dead.

Your funding source stays hidden

The agent never touches your credit card, bank account, or Privacy.com key. Each approved purchase gets a single-use virtual card delivered through a time-limited view link, so a compromised agent leaks one disposable card and nothing else.

Works with the clients you use

Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, and ChatGPT connect over OAuth with no API key to manage. Claude Code, Codex, and custom agent frameworks authenticate by passing the per-agent API key as a bearer token in the MCP config. Same server, same tools, either way.

MCP-原生支付基础设施

AI代理支付的授权和控制层

Authoryze 让您的人工智能代理可以通过现代支付方式进行支付，同时您可以执行支出限制、批准、商家规则和完整的审计跟踪。 购买力为您的代理商，控制权为您。

控制代理支出的各个方面。

限制、批准、商家规则和完整的审计跟踪，全部在服务器端强制执行。

代理商花钱的地方。

一旦你给代理商一张附有规则的卡片，他们就会进行真正的购买。

按运行付费 API 支出

您的代理会为 OpenAI、Anthropic 或其依赖的任何 API 充值，每次收费都会抽取一张一次性卡，而不是持有真实的卡。

自筹资金的活动

您的代理会在广告系列投放时补充 Google 或元广告预算，其范围为您批准的金额，而不是您的实际卡金额。

代理选项卡上的订阅

您的代理在一张一次性卡上注册所需的数据、抓取或软件工具，该卡在收费后就会失效。

在限制范围内购买下降

您的机器人会在有限的运动鞋发布后立即检查它，并自动批准，因为它低于您的阈值，并且商店位于您的允许列表中，没有共享卡，没有长期访问权限。

你的真实卡永远不会暴露。

当代理准备付款时，Authoryze 会通过 Mastercard 或 Visa 发行一张一次性虚拟卡，适用于经批准的购买。 您的真实卡和资金详细信息永远不会到达代理。 每张卡只能使用一次，达到批准的金额后就失效了。

您的资金来源保持隐藏

代理绝不会接触您的信用卡、银行帐户或 Privacy.com 密钥。 每次批准的购买都会通过限时查看链接获得一张一次性虚拟卡，因此受感染的代理只会泄露一张一次性卡，而不会泄露任何其他信息。

与您使用的客户端合作

Claude Desktop、Claude.ai 和 ChatGPT 通过 OAuth 连接，无需管理 API 密钥。 Claude Code、Codex 和自定义代理框架通过将每个代理 API 密钥作为 MCP 配置中的不记名令牌传递来进行身份验证。 无论哪种方式，相同的服务器，相同的工具。
